annotations.title: Company profile from Wikidata and LEI records

description: Company card for a domain or name. From Wikidata: QID, label, description, websites, inception, industries, headquarters, country, latest employee count, parent organizations, stock listings and tickers, founders (names only), legal form, LEI. From GLEIF when an LEI is known or a legal name matches exactly: legal name, jurisdiction, entity and registration status, legal and HQ city/country, parents. With match method and confidence. Sources: Wikidata, GLEIF (CC0). Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. novartis.com. Matched against Wikidata official website statements. Either domain or name is required.

name.description: Company name, 2 to 100 characters, e.g. Novartis AG. Matched against Wikidata labels and aliases (organizations only) and GLEIF exact legal names.
